plainEnglish.summary: Text must maintain strong visual contrast against its background so it can be easily read by everyone, including people with low vision or under bright light.
plainEnglish.whyItMatters: Faint or low-contrast text forces users to strain their eyes and makes reading impossible for low-vision users.
plainEnglish.realWorldExample: Dark grey text (#333333) on a white background (#ffffff) provides a high 12.6:1 contrast ratio.

personaBreakdown.designer: Test all typography colors against backgrounds using APCA and WCAG contrast tools.
personaBreakdown.developer: Ensure CSS custom properties enforce compliant foreground and background hex values.
personaBreakdown.qa: Audit text elements across light and dark themes using Chrome DevTools Color Picker.
personaBreakdown.productManager: Reject brand color choices that cause accessibility failures.

statusSummary.workingGroupDebate: W3C working group is transitioning from WCAG 2 ratio formulas to APCA (Advanced Perceptual Contrast Algorithm) for better perceptual accuracy.
statusSummary.keyChallenges: Balancing dark mode aesthetics with high perceptual readability.

testingGuide.automated: axe-core color contrast audit; Lighthouse contrast test.
testingGuide.manualKeyboard: Inspect text readability across viewport zoom levels (up to 400%).
testingGuide.screenReader: Visual readability check for sighted screen reader users.

wcag22Comparison.deltaExplanation: WCAG 3 incorporates visual context (font weight, spatial frequency, ambient light) rather than fixed static ratios.
